data.name: Costel
data.long_meaning: The name Costel is derived from the Latin word 'costus', meaning 'expense' or 'value'. In the Roman culture, this name was given to children born during times of great cost or expense. The name carries a strong sense of valuation and worth.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the cost of discipleship in following Christ.

data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Costel can be seen as a reminder of the value of life and the expense of love. Ultimately, the name Costel inspires a deep appreciation for the worth of life and the love that sustains it.
